meta.title: BMI Calculator — Body Mass Index Calculator
meta.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) from your height and weight. See which weight category you fall into — underweight, normal, overweight, or obese.

howItWorks: Enter your weight and height in the input fields.
The calculator uses the BMI formula: weight (kg) divided by height (m) squared.
Your BMI is matched to a standard category to indicate your weight status.
howToUse: Enter your weight in kilograms or pounds.
Enter your height in centimeters, meters, or feet/inches.
Click Calculate to see your BMI and weight category.

faq.question: What is a healthy BMI range?
faq.answer: A BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is considered normal. Below 18.5 is underweight, 25–29.9 is overweight, and 30 or above is obese.

faq.question: Is BMI accurate for athletes?
faq.answer: BMI does not distinguish between muscle and fat. Athletes with high muscle mass may get a high BMI despite being healthy. Use it as a general guide.

faq.question: Can I use this with imperial units?
faq.answer: Yes. The calculator supports both metric (kg, cm) and imperial (lbs, feet/inches) units.
